supply_pressure.detail_ko: 870 임시 부모비자와 달리 영주 부모비자(143·103·864·804)는 연간 쿼터제(s 85 Queue)가 적용되어 143 기여제 기준 November 2018 큐 확정분까지 배정 중입니다 (31 August 2026 기준).
supply_pressure.detail_en: Unlike temporary Subclass 870, permanent Parent visas (143/103/864/804) are capped and queued under s 85 (143 released up to November 2018 as at 31 August 2026).

regime.summary_en: Median processing time (210d→210d) has remained within a stable corridor since 2026-04-01.
